text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali recommends campaign among Tunisians abroad to persuade them to invest in Tunisia.
- Investment of more than 10 million dinars in construction of tunnels and roads in Tunis.
- President receives Morocco's General Abdelhak Kadiri for talks on bilateral relations.
- Parliament approves budgets of ministries of finance and foreign affairs.
- Foreign Affairs Minister Ben Yahia says Tunisia firmly attached to establishment of Maghreb Arab Union.
- Prime Minister Karoui continues visit to Jordan, meets parliament speaker.
